```{r}
#| label: setup-cohabitation
#| include: false
# The data of the cohabitation case and the figures drawn from them, read
# once for every segment of the case. Comes after the shared setup chunk and
# uses its palette, theme and number formats. The files and their codebooks
# are in cases/cohabitation/data/, written by R/cohabitation/ (menu_options.csv
# by a script of _planning/cohabitation/tools/); every number on the slides is
# computed from them or taken from _planning/cohabitation/cohabitation-facts.md.
# Estimates are coefficients of the later cohort on the log scale, and an
# estimate below zero is the direction of the claim. The files are read with
# readr rather than datawizard::data_read(), which reads empty cells as ""
# rather than NA and the codes of the cases, strata and clusters as numbers.
data_dir <- "../cases/cohabitation/data"

# The addresses of the case, which the shared segments print. The record of
# Multi100 lists a source-data reproduction for this paper, so it is not one
# of the nine papers whose reproduction was never attempted, and the SCORE
# slide of Part 1 must not say that it is. The browser lab of the case is a
# demonstration, which fits no model before Task 3, and the shared slides on
# the lab say so.
case_vars <- yaml::read_yaml("../_variables.yml")$cases$cohabitation |>
  c(list(`multi100-repro-never-attempted` = FALSE, `lab-demonstration` = TRUE))

# The unions rebuilt from the NSFG, and the unions of the paper: begun no more
# than five years before the interview, lasting at least a month, and in
# 2006-2010 begun in 2005 or later. The case numbers, strata and clusters are
# codes, so they are read as text.
unions <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "cohab_unions.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE,
                          col_types = readr::cols(caseid = readr::col_character(),
                                                  stratum = readr::col_character(),
                                                  psu = readr::col_character()))
paper_unions <- unions |>
  datawizard::data_filter(cycle %in% c("1995", "2006-10"), since_start <= 60, !is.na(duration), duration >= 1,
                          cycle != "2006-10" | from_2005)
oc <- \(cycle_code, outcome_code) sum(paper_unions$cycle == cycle_code & paper_unions$outcome == outcome_code)
composition <- paper_unions |>
  datawizard::data_summary(unions = n(),
                           hispanic = stats::weighted.mean(race == "hispanic", weight),
                           black = stats::weighted.mean(race == "black", weight),
                           white = stats::weighted.mean(race == "white", weight),
                           college = stats::weighted.mean(educ == "college", weight),
                           age_start = stats::weighted.mean(age_start, weight),
                           by = "cycle")
cmp <- \(cycle_code, col) composition[[col]][composition$cycle == cycle_code]
# One row for every month in which a union could end, as person_months() of
# the workspace builds them: every union contributes `duration` + 1
# months, from the month in which the couple moved in to the month of the
# marriage, the separation or the interview
n_person_months <- sum(paper_unions$duration + 1)
n_pm_marriages <- sum(paper_unions$outcome == "marriage")

# The file that Multi100 gave the analysts: its rows of 1995 and 2006-2010,
# the rows that record a marriage, and its unions (the last row of each woman)
score <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "score_person_months.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
score_rows <- score |>
  datawizard::data_filter(P95 == 1 | P10 == 1) |>
  datawizard::data_summary(rows = n(), married = sum(OUTCOME == 2), by = "P95")
sr <- \(p95, col) score_rows[[col]][score_rows$P95 == p95]
score_unions <- score |>
  datawizard::data_filter(P95 == 1 | P10 == 1) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(MONTHNUM, n = 1, by = CASEID) |>
  datawizard::data_modify(survey = dplyr::if_else(P95 == 1, "1995", "2006-10"),
                          outcome = c("intact", "marriage", "separation")[OUTCOME])
su <- \(survey_code, outcome_code) sum(score_unions$survey == survey_code & score_unions$outcome == outcome_code)
# Which of the 929 unions of 1990-1995 the file holds, by outcome
in_file <- paper_unions |>
  datawizard::data_filter(cycle == "1995") |>
  datawizard::data_modify(in_score = caseid %in% as.character(score_unions$CASEID)) |>
  datawizard::data_summary(n = n(), by = c("outcome", "in_score"))
kept <- \(outcome_code) sum(in_file$n[in_file$outcome == outcome_code & in_file$in_score])

# The curve of 144, ranked from the largest decline (rank 1) to the smallest,
# as the Multiverse page and the workspace draw it
curve <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "spec_curve.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE,
                         col_types = readr::cols(stat_type = readr::col_character())) |>
  datawizard::data_arrange("b") |>
  datawizard::data_modify(rank = 1:n())
curve_ref <- datawizard::data_filter(curve, is_reference)
# Placement as try_spec() prints it: the specifications further below zero
further_below <- \(x) sum(curve$b < x - 1e-9)
placement_ref <- further_below(curve_ref$b)
by_window <- curve |>
  datawizard::data_summary(lo = min(b), hi = max(b), mean = mean(b), by = "cohorts")
bw <- \(window, col) by_window[[col]][by_window$cohorts == window]

# Share of the variance of the 144 estimates carried by each decision: the eta
# squared of each decision in a main-effects model (effectsize), the sum of
# squares of the decision over the total; the residual holds the interactions
var_eta <- stats::lm(b ~ cohorts + horizon + adjust + weights + time + model, data = curve) |>
  effectsize::eta_squared(partial = FALSE, ci = NULL)
var_share <- c(stats::setNames(var_eta$Eta2, var_eta$Parameter), Residuals = 1 - sum(var_eta$Eta2))

analysts <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "analysts5.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
repro <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "display_reproduction.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
score_file <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "display_score_file.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
shares <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "display_shares.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
subgroups <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "display_subgroups.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
inference <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "display_inference.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE,
                             col_types = readr::cols(stat_type = readr::col_character()))
options_d <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "display_options.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE,
                             col_types = readr::cols(stat_type = readr::col_character()))
deviations <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "menu_deviations.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
menu_opts <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "menu_options.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
lifetable <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "display_lifetable.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
marks <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "reference_marks.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

# One value of a record or display file, for inline use
an <- \(id_code, col) analysts[[col]][analysts$id == id_code]
mark_of <- \(id_code, col) marks[[col]][marks$mark == id_code]
rp <- \(model_no, term_code, col, eq = "marriage") {
  repro[[col]][repro$model == model_no & repro$term == term_code & repro$equation == eq]
}
sf <- \(source_name, cycle_code, col) score_file[[col]][score_file$source == source_name & score_file$cycle == cycle_code]
sh <- \(cohort_code, type, group_code, col) {
  shares[[col]][shares$cohort == cohort_code & shares$group_type == type & shares$group == group_code]
}
sg <- \(model_code, group_code, col) subgroups[[col]][subgroups$model == model_code & subgroups$group == group_code]
inf <- \(rule, col) inference[[col]][inference$errors == rule]
opt <- \(changed_code, option_code, col) {
  options_d[[col]][options_d$changed == changed_code & options_d$option == option_code]
}
dev_of <- \(axis_code, option_code, col) {
  deviations[[col]][deviations$axis == axis_code & deviations$option == option_code]
}
lt36 <- datawizard::data_filter(lifetable, group_type == "all", month == 36)
lt <- \(cohort_code, col) lt36[[col]][lt36$cohort == cohort_code]
fmt_p <- \(p) if (p < 1e-4) "p < 0.0001" else if (p < 0.001) "p < 0.001" else paste("p =", fmt_num(p, 3))
# the same for a table cell under a heading "p"
p_cell <- \(p) sub("^p (= )?", "", fmt_p(p))
# a statistic as Multi100 recorded it, with the digits of the record
recorded_txt <- \(type, x) dplyr::case_when(
  is.na(x) ~ "none recorded",
  type == "chi2" ~ paste0("$\\chi^2$ = ", gsub("-", "−", formatC(x, format = "fg", digits = 5))),
  .default = paste0("*", type, "* = ", gsub("-", "−", formatC(x, format = "fg", digits = 5)))
)
stat_txt <- \(type, x, d = 2) dplyr::case_when(
  type == "chi2" ~ paste0("$\\chi^2$ = ", fmt_num(x, d)),
  .default = paste0("*", type, "* = ", fmt_num(x, d))
)

# The curve, the marks and the class chart share one visual grammar: a plain
# blue for the marks of the curve, the two cohort windows in the blues of the
# workspace figure, ink for the reference results
plain <- "#1f5fa8"
bronze <- "#8c5a10"
window_cols <- c(paper = "#0e3b6a", five_years = "#6497c8")
window_labels <- c(paper = "window of the paper", five_years = "same five-year window in both")
cohort_cols <- c(`1990-1995` = ncl_blue, `2005-2010` = burgundy)
cohort_labels <- c(`1990-1995` = "begun 1990–1995", `2005-2010` = "begun 2005–2010")
outcome_cols <- c(marriage = ncl_blue, separation = "#c9a227", intact = "#b6bcc3")
log_lab <- \(x) fmt_num(x, 1)

# The curve of 144: one mark per specification, ranked by the estimate, an
# open circle for p < 0.05 with design-based errors and a cross otherwise.
# `colour_by` = "cohorts" colours the marks by the cohort window.
# coord_cartesian() fixes the range, so that an overlay never rescales the
# axis between consecutive slides.
curve_base <- function(colour_by = NULL) {
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(curve, ggplot2::aes(rank, b)) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = grey_mid, linewidth = 0.4)
  p <- if (is.null(colour_by)) {
    p + ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(shape = sig), colour = plain, alpha = 0.45, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.8)
  } else {
    p + ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(shape = sig, colour = .data[[colour_by]]), alpha = 0.85, size = 2.4, stroke = 0.9) +
      ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = window_cols, labels = window_labels, breaks = names(window_cols),
                                   name = NULL) +
      # the class of p first, then the windows: ggplot2 otherwise orders the
      # two legends by a hash that changes with the class of the data frame
      ggplot2::guides(shape = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1), colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 2))
  }
  p +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 4), breaks = c(TRUE, FALSE),
                       labels = c("p < 0.05", "p ≥ 0.05"), name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-1, 0, 0.1), labels = log_lab) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = sprintf("specification, ranked from the largest decline (%d)", nrow(curve)),
         y = "coefficient of the later\ncohort (log scale)") +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.95, 0.02), xlim = c(0, nrow(curve) + 2)) +
    theme_slide(15) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "right",
          legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, -6, 0))
}

# Reference results as ink marks on the curve, each placed by the count of
# specifications further below zero, as a class result is, and joined by a
# thin line to a tag in the empty space above the curve. The tags are stacked
# in the order of the marks, smallest decline on top, so that no two lines
# cross.
mark_layer <- function(m, label_x = 58, top = -0.22, gap = 0.075) {
  tags <- m |>
    dplyr::mutate(rank = purrr::map_dbl(b, further_below) + 0.5) |>
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(b)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(lab_y = top - gap * (dplyr::row_number() - 1))
  list(
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = tags, ggplot2::aes(x = label_x + 1, xend = rank, y = lab_y, yend = b),
                 colour = "#9aa3ab", linewidth = 0.35, inherit.aes = FALSE),
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = tags, ggplot2::aes(x = rank, y = b), shape = 1, colour = ink,
               size = 3.4, stroke = 1.1, inherit.aes = FALSE),
    ggplot2::geom_label(data = tags, ggplot2::aes(x = label_x, y = lab_y, label = tag), colour = ink,
               fill = "#FFFFFFE6", size = 3.6, linewidth = 0.2, hjust = 1,
               label.padding = grid::unit(2.5, "pt"), inherit.aes = FALSE)
  )
}

# The causal graph of Task 2, as R/dag_starter.R of the workspace draws it:
# the period on the left, marriage on the right, the characteristics of the
# woman above the line between them and the selection into cohabitation
# below it (the age at the start sits a little further right than in the
# workspace, clear of the arrow from education to marriage). The arrow of the claim is a dashed green line. `view` = "all"
# draws the graph among all women; "cohabitors" boxes the selection in red
# and turns red the arrows of the three paths that it opens; "composition"
# boxes education and race-ethnicity as well, and the paths that they close
# turn pale.
dag_nodes <- tibble::tribble(
  ~name,       ~x,   ~y,
  "period",    0,    0,
  "marriage",  4,    0,
  "race",      1.2,  1.6,
  "education", 2.6,  1.8,
  "age_start", 3.85, 1.25,
  "cohabits",  2,   -1.4
) |>
  dplyr::mutate(half_w = 0.12 + 0.05 * nchar(name), half_h = 0.2,
                role = dplyr::case_when(name == "period" ~ "exposure", name == "marriage" ~ "outcome",
                                        .default = "other"))
dag_edges <- tibble::tribble(
  ~from,       ~to,
  "period",    "cohabits",
  "education", "cohabits",
  "race",      "cohabits",
  "education", "marriage",
  "race",      "marriage",
  "education", "age_start",
  "age_start", "marriage"
)

# how far along a unit vector (ux, uy) the edge of a box lies
to_edge <- \(ux, uy, w, h) pmin(w / pmax(abs(ux), 1e-9), h / pmax(abs(uy), 1e-9))

# Arrows between the boxes of the nodes, each stopped at the edge of both boxes
dag_segments <- function(edges, nodes) {
  tails <- dplyr::select(nodes, from = name, x0 = x, y0 = y, w0 = half_w, h0 = half_h)
  heads <- dplyr::select(nodes, to = name, x1 = x, y1 = y, w1 = half_w, h1 = half_h)
  edges |>
    dplyr::left_join(tails, by = "from") |>
    dplyr::left_join(heads, by = "to") |>
    dplyr::mutate(len = sqrt((x1 - x0)^2 + (y1 - y0)^2),
           ux = (x1 - x0) / len, uy = (y1 - y0) / len,
           s0 = to_edge(ux, uy, w0, h0) + 0.03,
           s1 = to_edge(ux, uy, w1, h1) + 0.07,
           x = x0 + s0 * ux, y = y0 + s0 * uy,
           xend = x1 - s1 * ux, yend = y1 - s1 * uy)
}

cohab_dag <- function(view = c("all", "cohabitors", "composition")) {
  view <- match.arg(view)
  state <- c(all = "plain", cohabitors = "opened", composition = "closed")[[view]]
  segs <- dag_segments(dplyr::mutate(dag_edges, state = state), dag_nodes)
  held <- switch(view, all = character(0), cohabitors = "cohabits",
                 composition = c("cohabits", "education", "race"))
  boxes <- dplyr::filter(dag_nodes, name %in% held) |>
    dplyr::mutate(kind = dplyr::if_else(name == "cohabits", "selected", "held"))
  edge_cols <- c(plain = "grey40", closed = "grey82", opened = d_red)
  node_fill <- c(exposure = ncl_blue, outcome = burgundy, other = "grey45")
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
    ggplot2::annotate("segment", x = 0.55, xend = 3.35, y = 0, yend = 0, colour = green, linewidth = 1.1,
             linetype = "22", arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(9, "pt"), type = "closed")) +
    ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.95, y = 0.24, label = "the claim", colour = green, fontface = "bold",
             size = 4.8) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = segs, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend, colour = state),
                 linewidth = 0.9, arrow = grid::arrow(length = grid::unit(8, "pt"), type = "closed")) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = edge_cols, guide = "none")
  if (nrow(boxes) > 0) {
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_rect(data = boxes,
                       ggplot2::aes(xmin = x - half_w - 0.08, xmax = x + half_w + 0.08,
                           ymin = y - half_h - 0.1, ymax = y + half_h + 0.1),
                       fill = NA, colour = dplyr::if_else(boxes$kind == "selected", d_red, ncl_blue),
                       linewidth = 1.2)
  }
  p +
    ggplot2::geom_label(data = dag_nodes, ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = name, fill = role), colour = "white",
               fontface = "bold", size = 5.6, linewidth = 0,
               label.r = grid::unit(5, "pt"), label.padding = grid::unit(6, "pt")) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = node_fill, guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::coord_fixed(xlim = c(-0.7, 4.7), ylim = c(-1.9, 2.2)) +
    ggplot2::theme_void()
}
```
